whatIs.title: What is Inbound & Outbound AI Calling?
whatIs.para1: An AI phone assistant is an intelligent virtual receptionist that handles both incoming and outgoing phone calls completely automatically. Your AI assistant answers incoming calls professionally, captures customer information, books meetings, and can also reach out to customers with reminders or announcements.
whatIs.para2: Unlike a traditional receptionist, our AI works 24/7 without breaks, vacations, or sick days. Your team gets more time for valuable work, your customers get fast and professional service, and you save significant salary costs.
whatIs.para3: Choose to handle inbound calls only (customer service), outbound calls only (outreach), or a combined solution that does both.

faq.question: What's the difference between inbound and outbound calls?
faq.answer: Inbound calls are when customers call you – AI answers and handles their questions. Outbound calls are when AI calls your customers – e.g., with reminders, confirmations, or campaigns. You can use both or just what fits your business.

faq.question: How many calls can the AI handle at once?
faq.answer: AI can handle unlimited simultaneous calls. You pay only for actual talk time, not capacity. A full-time receptionist handles 5-10 calls daily; our AI handles hundreds.

faq.question: Does it work in English?
faq.answer: Yes, the system is fully optimized for English. AI understands natural speech patterns and accents. We also support Danish, French, Spanish, and Portuguese – AI adapts automatically.

faq.question: Can I listen to calls afterwards?
faq.answer: Yes, all calls are recorded and summarized. You get a transcript and can listen to the full call in your dashboard. You also get a brief summary of what was agreed upon.

faq.question: What if a customer needs to speak to a human?
faq.answer: AI automatically recognizes when human intervention is needed. The call can transfer directly to your team, or AI can take a message and you can call back later.

faq.question: Is it legal to make automated outbound calls?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as you comply with GDPR and local regulations. You need customer consent and they must be able to opt out. Our system helps you handle all of this correctly.

faq.question: How much money will I save?
faq.answer: A full-time receptionist typically costs €2,000-2,700/month. Our AI costs €200-800/month. That's 80-95% savings while providing better 24/7 service.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Book a free demo where we discuss your business and needs. We then set up the system with your specific instructions and you get 7 days free trial. After that, choose the plan that fits best.
